expectation.why_no_benefit_is_declared: Row 139: an expectation may be declared only from a measured conversion analogue. The two measured conversions on this programme are DELIVERY conversions of the gold boundary card to Perception (CONV 32 of 70 = 0.457143, KPROBE 24 of 55 = 0.436364). W3a delivers nothing new -- the delivered set is the AGREE arm's own, byte for byte -- it changes what an already-delivered card SAYS, and no contrast text has ever been flown and read. The analogue does not apply, so the cell is registered as a no-harm read and says so. no_harm_rule: NO-HARM READ (owner decision 164 brief, row 139): against the SHARED wave-1 in-chain A/A SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-WAVE1-AA-FOLD-A-V1 flown in the same chain, the paired CI95 lower bound of the intent-accuracy delta (primary, decision 133) is not below -0.9943 pp AND the paired CI95 lower bound of the official pooled SLU-F1 delta (the guard) is not below -1.2485 pp -- each metric read at its own Fold A own-null half-width (docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md section 2d). HARMFUL: a measured loss on either metric (CI95 upper bound below zero, decision 25). A CI that includes zero and clears the margin is the admission. The cell is NEVER reported as a gain whatever the point estimate: no measured conversion applies to contrast text, so no expected effect is declared (decision 139). Every verdict carries the per-scenario table in both weightings, the frontier row (decision 75), the row-level attribution of the delta to the rows the contrast lines newly name (membership fixed in offline-estimates-v1.json before contact), and the A/A's own delta against the sealed AGREE arm as the instrument's reading.
